title: Skellam Processes via Multiparameter Poisson Process
abstract: We introduce a mltiparameter version of Skellam point process via multiparameter Poisson processes. Its distributional properties are studied in detail. Its compound representation is derived for a particular case. Also, its Riemann integral over a rectangle in $\mathbb{R}^M_+$, $M\ge1$ is introduced and a closed expression for its characteristic function is obtained. Later, we introduce a different version of multiparameter Skellam process, and derive a weak convergence result for it. Moreover, a two parameter fractional Skellam process is discussed.
